cumleler: When can a blocked ear feeling be urgent?
Sudden hearing loss is often mistaken for a simple blocked ear.
With normal otoscopy and type A tympanogram, the cause may lie elsewhere.
Do pure-tone audiometry the same day, always including bone conduction.
If it is sensorineural, refer to an ENT physician the same day.
Treatment decisions belong to the physician, not the audiologist.
